tei:div.tei:p: (na)༄༅// kag chol gyi rjes gnang bzhugs// ༄༅/ na mo gu ru bhyaḥ rje btsun bla ma'i zhabs la gus btud nas// rjes gnang lung gi cho ga'i man ngag bri// 'dir gsang sngags kyi sgor zhugs pa'i rnal 'byor pas/ 'gro ba 'ga' zhig bsdu ba'i lung gi rjes gnang gi cho ga bya ba ni/ rgyud las/ rgyal po'i grong khyer la sogs gang zhig dbang du byed par 'dod na/ rdo rje cho ga rab bshad cing*// ring yang zla ba drug bzlas na// rnal 'byor pa yis bsgrub bya dbang*// ji ltar 'dod pa bzhin du 'grub// ces bshad pa'i man ngag yin pas/ 'di'i lung gi rjes gnang byed pa'i tshe/ thog mar gnas dben par/ ba'i rnam pa lnga byugs pa'i maṇḍal gru bzhi khru gang ba cig byas la/ tsandan dmar po gur gum/ gi wang gang rung gi chus chag chag btab pa'i steng du/ mtshal lam/ li khri'am/ ldong ros kyis phyi zla gam nyis rim pa/ kha nub du bstan pa/ padma 'dab ma brgyad lte ba dang bcas pa cig bri zhing mdun du mchod pa ci 'byor rgya cher bshams la/ bla ma dkon mchog la dbul/ tshogs kyi yo byad dang*/ dmar gtor rgyan can gnyis tsam bshams la/ byin gyis brlabs nas/ dpa' bo dang mkha' 'gro pho mo dang*/ chos skyong srung ma rnams la a kā ro'i sngags kyis mnyes par byas nas/ 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba gdab cing*/ phrin las gzhol/ de nas slob mas khrus byas la gos dmar gyon zhing*/ lag tu me tog dmar po thogs pas maṇḍal gyi mdun du kha nub tu bltas la 'dug ste/ skyabs 'gro dang sems bskyed rgya chen po sngon du song bas/ bla ma rdo rje 'chang chen por mos pa byas la/ rdzas yo byad ci 'byor rgya cher dbul zhing khyad par du me tog dmar po gus pas phul te/ 'di'i lung man ngag dang bcas pa gnang bar gsol ba gdab pa ni/ gus pas phyag byas thal mo sbyar me tog bzung nas/ rdo rje rnal 'byor dbang phyug gtso// gsang ba'i cho ga bla na med// dbang du byed pa'i rig sngags mchog

/bdag la nges par stsal du gsol// zhes lan gsum brjod cing*/ de'i rjes la dpon slob gnyis kas mthun par ting nge 'dzin bsgom pa ni/ slob dpon de nyid khro bo 'dod rgyal zhal gcig khro la 'dzum pa/ spyan gsum rab tu g.yo ba/ sku mdog dmar po padma rā ga'i mdog lta bu las/ 'od zer dmar po phyogs bcur 'phros pas/ 'gro ba sems can thams cad dbang du byed pa/ sku la rin po che dang rus pa'i rgyan drug gi mdzes par spras pa/ phyag gnyis kyis lcags sgrog lu gu rgyud du sbrel ba 'dzin pa/ zhabs gnyis padma dmar po dang nyi ma'i gdan la/ gar stabs 'gying pa'i g.yas kyi 'og tu yul 'khor srung dang*/ 'phags skyes po'i mgo mnan pa/ g.yon gyi 'og tu spyan mi bzang dang*/ rnam thos kyi bu'i mgo mnan pa'i thugs kar nyi zla kha sbyor gyi dbus su/ dbang du byed pa'i yi ge'i sa bon hrīḥdamar po mtha' mar/ sngags ring gi kha dog dmar po rim pa gsum gyis bskor ba las 'od zer dmar po 'phros pas slob ma'i thugs kar phog pas/ slob ma de yang khro bo 'dod rgyal du bskyed pa'i thugs kar nyi zla kha sbyor gyi dbus su hrīḥdamar po bsams la bla mas kyang phyag tu me tog bzung ste/ oṃ shāntiṃ ku ru la sogs pa'i sngags ring brjod pas/ slob dpon gyi zhal nas yi ge thams cad kha dog dmar po lu gu rgyud bzhin sbrel ba'i rnam par byung nas/ slob ma'i snying gar nyi zla kha sbyor gyi dbus su sa bon yi ge hrīḥ'i mtha' mar g.yon skor lan gsum bskor nas yod par bsgoms te/ byang sems chen pos kun nas bslangs nas sngags kyi rjes zlos lan gsum byed du bcug pas/ lung 'bogs sbyin te/ mthar bdag gi rgyud la yod pa'i nus mthu rnams rigs kyi bu 'di'i rgyud la 'byung bar mdzad du gsol/ lan gsum brjod/ mgor gtor ma'ang bzhag 'bru blugs gsung*/ de nas slob ma'i snying ga'i sngags rnams las 'od zer kha dog sna tshogs pa 'phros pas/

phyogs bcu'i bla ma dang dkon mchog la mnyes pa'i mchod pa rgya chen po phul/ sems can thams cad la phog pas/ de dag kun bdag la shin tu gus pas 'dud pa'i tshul gyis/ rang gi dbang du 'dus par bsgoms te/ de'i rjes la slob mas kyang thal mo sbyar te/ gsang sngags de nyid 'grub par byed pa'i tshig /bdag la gsang sngags gnang lags kyi// gsang sngags 'grub par mdzad du gsol// zhes lan gsum brjod la/ gzhan yang rnal 'byor ba bdag cag gis gdams ngag 'di bsgrub pa la/ phyi nang gi bar chad thams cad mi 'byung zhing mthun rkyen thams cad myur du 'grub par mdzad du gsol/ zhes kyang gsol ba btab nas bla ma mnyes pa'i yon ci 'byor pa phul la/ bla mas kyang me tog gtor zhing*/ bkra shis kyi tshigs bcad mang du brjod de/ de ltar byas nas dbang du bya ba'i rim pa rnams ji ltar bstan pa bzhin du myur du 'grub pa'i rten 'brel yod cing*/ de las gzhan lung med cing man ngag yod pa dang*/ man ngag shes kyang lung med pa gang gis kyang 'di mi 'grub gsungs te/ tshul de dag ni bla ma lung nod pa'i man ngag bla ma'i phyag bzhes shin tu zab pa'i snyan brgyud yi ger btab pa yin gsung*/ dbang byed gsang sngags rjes gnang mchog /snyan brgyud zhal la rag las rnams// gzhan phan yi ger bkod pa yis// 'gro kun chos la dbang sgyur shog /dbang sdud kag chol ma'i lung gi rjes gnang gi cho ga dpal ldan sa skya paṇḍi tas rgyas par bkod pa rdzogs so// //oṃ shāntiṃ ku ru ni bhrūm̐/ oṃ ku su mā ma le bhi hūm̐ dza/ oṃ badzra ku bha dzī kāṃ bhai ṭhaḥṭhaḥṭhaḥ oṃ gro ge ma kri te che ge mo/ ka kā dha ya kā dha ya/ kha khā hi khā hi/ ga gadzdza ya gadzdza ya/ gha ghā ta ya ghā ta ya/ tsa tsā la ya tsā la ya/ tsha tstsha da ya tstsha da ya/ dza dzambha ya dzambha ya/ dzha dzha ta ya dzha ta ya/ ṭa ṭā la ya ṭā la ya/ ṭha ṭhā ka ya ṭhā ka ya/ ḍa ḍambha ya ḍambha ya/ ḍha ḍhāṃ bha ya ḍhāṃ bha ya/

ṇa ṇā sha ya ṇā sha ya/ ta tambha ya tambha ya/ tha tho bha ya tho bha ya/ da dā ra ya dā ra ya/ dha dhā ra ya dhā ra ya/ na nā sha ya nā sha ya/ pa pa ta ye pa ta ye/ pha phā ta ya phā ta ya/ ba bā ta ya bā ta ya/ bha bhe da ya bhe da ya/ ma mā ra ya mā ra ya/ ya yo ha ya yo ha ya/ ra ro dha ya ro dha ya/ la lāmbha ya lāmbha ya/ wa wā ha ya wā ha ya/ sha sho ṣa ya sho ṣa ya/ ṣa ṣūṣṇiya ṣūṣṇi ya/ sa sā dha ya sā dha ya/ ha ha na ya ha na ya/ kṣa kṣo bha ya kṣo bha ya/ a mu sya kri te shīntaṃ ku ru puṣṭiṃ ku ru/ kṣ+maṃ ku ru/ kṣo bha ku ru/ kha raṃ ku ru/ oṃ siddhi sarba siddhi/ ma hā siddhi/ pū dza a ne ta bha na ta ma ra naṃ zhes so// // ༈ gu rus dpar rtsa spel ba'o//
